text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyy!!!!!
Ayy-ayyyyyyy☆★☆★☆彡

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bestieee! Crank up the speeeed♪
More, way way more!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, bestie! Go for a mega-lead, a crazy runaway,
and leave 'em all in the dust!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is!! OUR!!
FLOORRRRRRRRR!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOH?!

A shockwave rippled through the crowd. Typically, a Front Runner takes the lead alone to dominate the race.
That common sense had just been shattered to pieces.
“—A double runaway front-runner sprint. A reckless, all-out blast inspiring one another. And then—”

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahahahahahahah!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What is this?! We're totally wiped,
but isn't this hype? Isn't it crazy? Isn't this way too much fun~~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is it!!!!!! This is the absolute best!!!
Leaving our mark all over the GⅠs, MAX people☆

Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios
sprawled out side by side on the grass, limbs spread wide.

A free gale blowing through the sky.
Mejiro Palmer has at last—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is that running form...?
Honestly, it's totally nonsensical.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still... that was the scariest yet.
Out of all of Palmer's runs so far, the most terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I agree on that point.
However, causing such a massive commotion
both before and during the race――"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wonder what Grandmother would say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother? But Grandmother
isn't watching today... is she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Once a flight was chartered,
it seems they somehow made it in time."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Look, see from over there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"T-T-Trainer...!?
Don't tell me that's...!!"
In the very front row of the stands sat someone who shouldn't have been there. A stern, noble old lady. That's—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Why is Grandmother here~!?
Trainer, you said she wasn't gonna be here!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Totally!

"There's no use crying over spilled milk. What's done is done.
Though her face was stiff, Mejiro Palmer..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I-It's too late now anyway. It's not like
we can pretend it never happened. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Grandmooother~...☆
Yaaaay...

A party chant barely louder than a mosquito's buzz.
In response, Grandmother Mejiro—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A-Are you mad? Or do you just look that way~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A-Ah... Did I just...

No particular response came back.
Even so, from a distance...
I felt like the corners of their mouth loosened ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Waaaah, that just took years off my life~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still, Trainer, we did it! We actually pulled it off!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was an explosive run.
Yeah, that was quite a runaway run.

text_block_list.text:
If she can pull off this move, she has nothing to fear.
Mejiro Palmer can go anywhere and everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So Palm-chin, which race are we hitting next? I'll match my schedule with yours!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Will you run in the next one too, bestie?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? We're besties for life,
so we gotta walk side by side forever, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy, where is it?
What's next after our Takarazuka Kinen festival?
choice_data_list: After the festival... maybe a rematch against authority?

text_block_list.text: I was able to pull off party-people moves today, but I couldn't do it back during the Tenno Sho (Spring).

Only when you can act as freely as you did today
within such a prestigious race can it be called true freedom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Challenging authority once more... So that must mean...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Yeah, that makes sense..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The pressure is insane, too.
There's a chance things might end up just like they did in the spring..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-hoh, not on my watch, no way, no how☆
'Cause this time, I'm right beside you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We'll charge in together and totally pull through!
We're non-stoppable★ That's right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besties...! Yeah, totally!
As long as I have you, Helios...!

Their bond is unbreakable.
Not even a race steeped in history can make them waver.
Let's revel amidst the prestige of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) and show off how much we've grown since spring.
